title: Dev Utilities
author: VELMREN
annotation: Четыре локальных инструмента разработчика на русском и английском, в светлой и тёмной теме. JSON: запросы JSONPath (RFC 9535), конвертация в YAML, CSV, TypeScript и JSON Schema, сравнение, JSON Patch и проверка схемой без потери точности чисел. Цвет: OKLCH, перцептивные шкалы, контраст WCAG, симуляция нарушений цветового зрения. Хеши: SHA, CRC32, HMAC, сверка по спискам sha256sum. Base64: файлы, Data URI, hex-просмотр, JWT. Всё обрабатывается в браузере.
features: JSON editor / virtualized tree / live JSONPath with exact values / YAML, CSV, TypeScript, Schema export / diff and JSON Patch / Ajv 2020-12
Color HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH, OKLab / gamut marks / perceptual scales / WCAG contrast samples / vision simulation / CSS, Tailwind, W3C tokens
SHA-256 / SHA-512 / SHA-1 / CRC32 / HMAC / streaming file queue / checksum list verification and report
Unicode and binary Base64 / URL-safe / Data URI / hex view with file signatures / JWT decoding without signature verification
dataPersistence: Session by default; explicit opt-in saves text, options and palettes; language, theme and pane sizes remembered; files and HMAC keys never saved
notes: Interface in Russian and English; light and dark themes.
JSONPath passes all 706 tests of the official RFC 9535 compliance suite through the app's pipeline.
Schema 2020-12 with local references; unsafe numbers and duplicate keys block only ambiguous operations.
SHA-1 is legacy compatibility; CRC32 is integrity only; JWT signatures are not verified.
Independent portfolio project; synthetic examples; no publication.
